caption:
Today is a Dog day 🐕 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Dog meets the animal of the year you were born: Rabbit gets a best-friend day, Tiger and Horse a team day, Dragon a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Which animal are you? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #chinesezodiac #zodiacsigns #selfdiscovery #astrologer #chineseastrology #lunarcalendar #seasonsoflife #sundayvibes
day_line: The sun on a Dog day. Warm and loyal: good for family time and keeping promises, easy to overcommit.

lines.Yang Wood: Sunny Sunday energy. Go out, eat well and leave the laptop shut.
lines.Yin Wood: You've got something to say today. Say it over lunch, not over text.
lines.Yang Fire: Your crowd is bright today. Gather people; you'll be the warmest one there.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone takes the spotlight today. Clap for them; your turn is coming.
lines.Yang Earth: A slow morning brings a clear answer. Don't rush the coffee.
lines.Yin Earth: Family has your back today. Let them help with the chores for once.
lines.Yang Metal: Sunday pressure creeps in. Prep Monday for 20 minutes, then stop.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone praises your taste today. Take the compliment; don't explain it.
lines.Yang Water: A fun chance pops up today. Say yes if it fits your wallet.
lines.Yin Water: Plan the week's spending today. Ten minutes now saves stress later.

animal_tips.Tiger: Team outing day. You pick the place.
animal_tips.Rabbit: Your day. Call the friend you miss.
animal_tips.Dragon: Go easy. Skip the family debate.
animal_tips.Snake: Read a little, nap a little.
animal_tips.Horse: Join the group plan. It's a fun one.
animal_tips.Goat: Light chores, then a long walk.
animal_tips.Monkey: Fix one small thing at home.
animal_tips.Pig: Easy day. Treat yourself to dessert.
